bio.text: Ruben Cruz is a Republican candidate for Assembly District 38 in Queens, which the Queens Ledger describes as encompassing parts of Glendale, Ozone Park, Richmond Hill, Ridgewood and Woodhaven.

The Ledger describes him as a longtime Richmond Hill resident who grew up in the district, attended P.S. 62 and Richmond Hill High School, and graduated from Queens College with a degree in Theatre and Dance.

He worked in sales, then managed board meetings and other duties at the Clemente Soto Vélez Center, an arts hub on the Lower East Side, and launched a media company and a children's puppet theater, Patty Cake Theater, which has performed since 2006.
In 2022 he ran for State Senate District 16 and lost to John Liu, and in 2024 he ran for Assembly District 24 and lost to David Weprin.

sources.title: "Neighbors Before Politics:" Republican Ruben Cruz to Run for AD38
